concept: A dramatic close-up of young David gripping a stone in his slingshot with determined eyes, silhouetted against the massive shadow of Goliath looming behind him
composition: David positioned in the foreground on the left third, facing right toward the enormous silhouette of Goliath on the right two-thirds, creating a dramatic size contrast with dynamic diagonal tension
environment: Valley of Elah at golden hour with dusty terrain, rocky ground, and distant mountains bathed in warm dramatic lighting
